[1/2] Add an archive status filter to the portfolio search toolbar and expose each card's archived state to the live atlas

impact_assessment.why: The site shows archived repositories in the portfolio but offers no way to isolate them, and the live atlas knows the archived flag without rendering it
impact_assessment.benefits: Visitors can switch between all, active and archived repositories from the existing search section, including with a shareable URL
impact_assessment.risks: contract: card data attributes and URL filter state; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: archive query parameter only, no persisted state
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default to all projects so existing behaviour is unchanged; set data-archived on static and live cards; pin filtering, URL state and card attributes in tests

[1/3] Add a failing cache-coherence regression test: the new Status control must never run with an old cached app.js

impact_assessment.why: The deployed Status select is inert when GitHub Pages or the service worker serves a new index.html together with an old app.js
impact_assessment.benefits: Archived only filters on the first load after deployment, including for returning visitors with a stale shell cache
impact_assessment.risks: contract: script URLs, service worker shell version and cache recovery; dependency: none; concurrency: one reload on controller change; state: no persisted filter state change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Version the app script, add a small update/reload client, pin the version to the shell, keep the old cache key compatible

[1/4] Replace raw-image new-tab clicks with an in-page dialog viewer: navigable shots, captions, commit metadata and keyboard support, without changing the masonry layout

impact_assessment.why: Clicking a dossier screenshot leaves the site for a bare image file, losing the caption, commit context and gallery position; the masonry layout itself is good and should stay
impact_assessment.benefits: One consistent in-page viewer for gallery captures and the social preview, with previous/next, counter, caption/commit metadata, Escape/arrow keys, focus restoration and an explicit original-file link
impact_assessment.risks: contract: dossier markup and project.js change, service-worker precache must include new modules; dependency: none, zero-dependency modules only; concurrency: none; state: modal open/close and focus-restore state per page
impact_assessment.mitigation: Native dialog with feature-detected fallback to the existing link, pure index helpers unit-tested, static wiring tests, axe/Playwright review at desktop and mobile widths

[1/4] Review the last three commits and harden the gaps they left: versioned-asset cache coherence, the expanded topic shelf, dialog fallback hiding and screen-reader feedback in the screenshot viewer

impact_assessment.why: The archive/topic and screenshot-viewer work exposed three residual gaps: a controlled page can still receive an older app.js from the service-worker cache even when the HTML asks for a versioned URL, expanding 317 live topics creates a 3,564px shelf with Show fewer at the far end, and the viewer announces a position change without the new caption
impact_assessment.benefits: A versioned asset bypasses an older shell cache, the expanded topic shelf stays bounded with its collapse control first, the viewer announces position plus caption, and browsers without dialog support never show an empty viewer shell
impact_assessment.risks: contract: index/project markup, app.js and the sw/sw-client version markers; dependency: none; concurrency: worker activation and reload; state: shell cache keys, session recovery flag, topic shelf expansion
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bump the shell contract together to v9, add static and browser tests for every changed contract, keep the offline fallback, and run axe plus the full project gates before pushing
